title: Building a state: unions that did not last
goal: I can say when the Gran Colombia and other unions were created and why they broke up.
grammar: The passive with ser: unions created and dissolved

items: I can say when the Gran Colombia was created and dissolved.
I can say what the new countries needed in order to build a state.
I can say what happened to the Central American federation.
I can describe the Peru–Bolivian Confederation and how it ended.
I can use ser + past participle to say what was created, dissolved or defeated.
